text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 required scientific qualification. Current profile tests/probes provide condition reduction, decoder, output and executor checks; the trial backend/readout remains unfinished, so neither those tests nor provider banded-SPD parity can establish full CompactCondition/TrialBanded calibration. Preserve the four distinct comparisons and misspecified/null adequacy cases. The >=500 replicate condition is a floor, not by itself proof that coverage uncertainty supports a claim; report intervals and inconclusive results against declared tolerances. Freeze exact runtime/source/provider state and selection/noise policy before confirmation; evaluate selection-dependent sigma instead of treating conditional curvature as unconditional calibration. Scope already explicitly excludes finite-state requirements: do not promote optional PHRF-10/30 through this gate. Source/test inventory assessment only, no new simulation or calibration claim.
